applicability.rationale: Owned Worker preparation API with explicit standalone consumers/tests; currently not mounted, exported through package API, or deployed. This is preparation approval, not activation.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Actual scoped session and requested World must bind every SQL operation.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: SET ROLE from privileged session, configured-role mismatch or absent World cannot pass actual session/flags/head checks.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Scoped native dedicated-role lease operation; same binding is checked before and after the sensitive SQL call.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Renewal cannot silently reacquire, change generation, or accept duplicate live holder startup.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Remote takeover, changed prior tuple or initial RENEWED response is rejected and rolled back.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Native unchanged-fence renewal and expired takeover via existing acquire_world_writer_lease; exact ACQUIRED/TAKEN_OVER/RENEWED tuple validation.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Local single-flight and preflight assertion must not replace SQL single-writer fencing at economic commit.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A locally ACTIVE old holder after remote takeover is rejected by actual SQL guard; takeover after preflight still faces unchanged economic transaction guard.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Native dual-instance contention and stale-holder rejection; downstream guard and existing migration functions are unchanged.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Unacknowledged transaction outcome must never install a confirmed lease or trigger hidden retry.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Real committed acquisition followed by lost ACK remains UNKNOWN with no confirmed lease and no second transaction.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Hash-verified native real-COMMIT/lost-ACK case and reviewer release-failure negative control.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Drain rejects new operations immediately and waits for active SQL settlement/cleanup before terminal status.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Late connect, cancelled query with pending rollback or throwing synchronous release cannot create ready or prematurely successful drain.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Three independently executed negative controls on actual unchanged PostgresSqlDatabase plus inherited native in-flight renewal barrier.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Preparation approval cannot mount consumer, activate Clock/admission, or authorize production topology.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Treating local status.ready or suggested alarm/coordinator as production authority has no deployed/configured path in this patch.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: HOLD entry, package exports, schema, governance and economic code unchanged; ADR-03 time rules remain approved while hosting topology remains separately undecided.
